title: PUR-PO-01 Purchase Order Entry
summary: Ledgerline screen for raising standard or direct single-line purchase orders, requiring F3 Fetch before saving to avoid ERR-SCR-0221.
body:
PUR-PO-01 is the Ledgerline purchasing screen used to create, edit, and park single-line purchase orders [^r9][^r11][^r22]. It supports standard orders referencing an approved purchase request and direct orders without a request, but does not allow direct supplier dispatch or immediate authorisation from the entry form [^r1][^r6][^r22]. Users must run the Fetch function (`F3`) after populating or changing the supplier and item fields, or the subsequent save will be rejected [^r2][^r7][^r28][^r35].

| Field | Detail |
|---|---|
| Screen code | PUR-PO-01 |
| Title | Purchase Order Entry |
| Menu path | Menu Purchase > Order entry [^r11] |
| Permitted roles | PUR-EXEC, PUR-SR, SYS-ADMIN [^r11] |
| Primary services | `po_fetch`, `po_save` [^r12][^r18][^r20] |
| Order types | `STD` (Standard), `DIR` (Direct) [^r1][^r6] |

## Fields

Each purchase order raised on PUR-PO-01 accommodates exactly one line item in the grid [^r9].

* **PO NO (`po_no`)**: Purchase order document identifier; read-only [^r13].
* **PO TYPE (`po_type`)**: Mandatory order classification [^r13]. Supported values are `STD` for orders referencing an approved purchase request and `DIR` for direct low-value orders raised without a request [^r1][^r6]. `DIR` orders referencing a purchase request trigger error ERR-PO-0611, while `DIR` orders exceeding £50,000 gross value trigger [[err-po-0610|ERR-PO-0610]] [^r10][^r16].
* **SOURCE PR (`pr_no`)**: Optional request reference; populated with the approved request number when raising `STD` orders [^r1][^r18][^r33].
* **SUP CD (`sup_cd`)**: Mandatory supplier code [^r13][^r18].
* **ITEM CD (`itm_cd`)**: Mandatory item number [^r13][^r18]. The component lookup may experience query latency across large item families unless restricted by initial character input [^r27].
* **QTY (`qty`)**: Mandatory order quantity; populated by `po_fetch` when linked to a request [^r12][^r13].
* **RATE (`rate`)**: Mandatory unit price; populated by `po_fetch` from contracted rates [^r12][^r13]. Pressing `F2` in this field opens a historical rate look-up window displaying previous agreed purchase rates, references, and statuses for the selected supplier and item, transferring the selected value directly into the line [^r25][^r26].
* **PAY TERM (`pt_cd`)**: Payment terms; retrieved via `po_fetch`; read-only [^r12][^r13].
* **TAX CD (`tax_cd`)**: Mandatory tax classification [^r13]. Populated by `po_fetch` with default `VAT20-UK` representing plant location [^r3][^r15][^r19]. For non-UK suppliers, users must manually change this field to `VAT20-RC` to avoid validation failure on save [^r3][^r8][^r15][^r19][^r36].
* **CC CD (`cc_cd`)**: Mandatory cost centre code; populated by `po_fetch` [^r12][^r13].
* **NEED DT (`need_dt`)**: Mandatory required delivery date; populated by `po_fetch` [^r12][^r13].
* **STATUS (`status`)**: Header purchase order status; read-only [^r13]. Possible values include Draft (`DR`), Pending Approval (`PA`), or Approved (`AP`) [^r4][^r17].
* **DELIVERY REMARKS**: Text field for special transit or carriage instructions to alert receiving personnel to pallet drops or oversized deliveries [^r40].

## Keys and services

* **F2 (Rate History)**: Accessible within the Rate field; invokes the previous rate enquiry pop-up for the active supplier and item [^r25]. Cancelling returns to the field without updating values [^r26].
* **F3 (Fetch / `po_fetch`)**: Executes read service `po_fetch` under [[services-pur-po|PUR po services]] using mandatory inputs `sup_cd` and `itm_cd`, and optional input `pr_no` [^r12][^r18]. It retrieves the contract rate, lead periods, descriptions, payment terms, cost centre, need date, quantity, and defaults `tax_cd` to `VAT20-UK` [^r12][^r18][^r19][^r34].
* **F8 (Save / `po_save`)**: Invokes backend service `po_save` to record order details [^r20]. Upon write completion, the bottom status bar displays `SAVED` regardless of whether the document remains uncommitted or stuck in status `DR`, `PA`, or `AP` [^r4][^r37].
* **Order submission**: Submitting an order transfers it to [[screen-pur-poa-04|PUR-POA-04]] for approval [^r23]. Any subsequent line modification returns the order to an unapproved state [^r23]. If rejected during approval, the order returns to PUR-PO-01 with notification for the creator [^r24].

## Messages

* **[[err-scr-0221|ERR-SCR-0221]] (`FETCH NOT DONE`)**: Raised on save when the user has not performed an explicit `F3` Fetch action for the current supplier and item combination, or if either field was modified after fetching [^r2][^r7][^r14][^r28][^r35].
* **[[err-po-0412|ERR-PO-0412]] (`TAX CODE DOES NOT MATCH SUPPLIER COUNTRY`)**: Raised on save when an order for an overseas supplier retains the default UK tax code `VAT20-UK` instead of `VAT20-RC` [^r3][^r8][^r15][^r19].
* **[[err-po-0610|ERR-PO-0610]]**: Raised on save if a direct purchase order (`DIR`) exceeds the gross monetary limit of £50,000 [^r10][^r16].
* **ERR-PO-0611**: Raised on save if a direct purchase order (`DIR`) references a purchase request [^r10].
* **[[w-cc-114|W-CC-114]]**: Amber warning banner displayed when saving an order allocated to a closed cost centre [^r17][^r21][^r29]. The order is stored in Draft status (`DR`) with editable lines, commitment is blocked, and the status bar displays `SAVED` [^r5][^r17][^r21][^r29].
* **W-SUP-0207 (`UN38.3 CERTIFICATE MISSING OR EXPIRED`)**: Advisory status bar warning generated when system parameter `PUR.CERT_CHK` is set to `Y` and an order is saved for an item flagged as a lithium cell whose supplier lacks a valid UN 38.3 certificate on the order date [^r30][^r31]. The warning is non-fatal and allows the order to save [^r31][^r32].

## Versions and conflicts

* **Fetch requirement before save**: Today, `F3` Fetch must be executed for the identical supplier and item combination prior to saving, otherwise save is halted with [[err-scr-0221|ERR-SCR-0221]] (`MAN-PUR-72 v7.2.3`, `RN-7.2.3`, `QRC-02 v2026.1`) [^r7][^r28][^r35]. In obsolete 2016 intranet guidance (`11_training/intranet_export_2016/how_to_raise_an_order.html`), Fetch was described as optional with rates entered manually (`superseded`) [^r39].
* **Single-line versus multi-line orders**: Today, PUR-PO-01 permits only one item line per purchase order document (`MAN-PUR-72 v7.2.3`) [^r9]. From March 2027 under Ledgerline ERP 7.3 preview, PUR-PO-01 will support multi-line purchase orders on a single document header (`RN-7.3-PREVIEW`) (`future_dated`) [^r41].
* **UN 38.3 validation severity**: Today, when `PUR.CERT_CHK=Y`, missing or expired UN 38.3 certificates issue an advisory status warning `W-SUP-0207` while permitting the order save to complete (`RN-7.2.3-P4`) [^r31][^r32]. From March 2027 under Ledgerline ERP 7.3 preview, a non-compliant or expired certificate on any cell line will hard-block the entire order with [[err-sup-0207|ERR-SUP-0207]] (`RN-7.3-PREVIEW`) (`future_dated`) [^r42].

r1.quote: raise the order on PUR-PO-01 with order type STD and the request number in Source PR.

r2.quote: Press F3 (Fetch) after entering the supplier and the item. Save is refused with ERR-SCR-0221 if Fetch was not run.

r3.quote: Check the tax code before saving. Fetch always fills VAT20-UK. For a supplier outside the UK change it to VAT20-RC, or Save fails with ERR-PO-0412.

r4.quote: Press F8 and read the Status field, not just the status bar. SAVED appears whatever the status.

r5.quote: DR means the order is stuck (usually a closed cost centre, warning W-CC-114); PA means it waits for approval; AP means it can be released.

r6.quote: STD (standard) orders are raised against an approved purchase request; enter the request number in Source PR. DIR (direct) orders have no request and are allowed only for small values

r7.quote: Ledgerline 7.2.3 refuses to save an order on which Fetch was not run for the current supplier and item, with ERR-SCR-0221 (FETCH NOT DONE).

r8.quote: For a supplier in another country you must change it to the reverse-charge code (-RC) before saving; otherwise Save fails with ERR-PO-0412.

r9.quote: Ledgerline 7.2 allows one line per order on this screen; for several items, raise several orders.

r10.quote: A DIR order is refused on Save if its gross value is above the direct-order limit configured for your company (shipped default £50,000), with ERR-PO-0610. Raise a purchase request instead. A DIR order may not refer to a request (ERR-PO-0611).

r11.quote: Menu: Purchase > Order entry. Roles: PUR-EXEC, PUR-SR, SYS-ADMIN.

r12.quote: Enter the source request, supplier and item, then press Fetch: it brings in the contract rate, tax code, payment terms and the request's cost centre, date and quantity.

r13.quote: PO NO po_no str Read-only PO TYPE po_type str Yes PR NO pr_no str No pr_search SUP CD sup_cd str Yes sup_search

r14.quote: Save needs Fetch for the same supplier and item ERR-SCR-0221

r15.quote: Fetch defaults the tax code to the plant's state; an overseas supplier needs the -RC code ERR-PO-0412

r17.quote: Closed cost centre: saved as Draft (DR); the message only says SAVED W-CC-114

r18.quote:
service: po_fetch
title: PO DEFAULTS
module: PUR
kind: read
screen: PUR-PO-01

r19.quote: tax_cd is always returned as VAT20-UK, whatever the supplier's country. An overseas supplier needs VAT20-RC on po_save (ERR-PO-0412). fetch_tok is valid once, for this supplier and item.

r20.quote:
service: po_save
title: PO SAVE
module: PUR
kind: write
screen: PUR-PO-01

r21.quote: Read data.status: DR (for example a closed cost centre, warning W-CC-114), PA, or AP.

r22.quote: Users who previously handled the full requisition cycle within a single window will find that PUR-PO-01 is restricted to raising, editing, and parking lines.

r23.quote: Instead, once an order is submitted, the record passes out of PUR-PO-01 and appears in the worklist for the approval stage

r24.quote: rejection at the approval stage returns the record to PUR-PO-01 with clear notice for the originator.

r25.section: Purchasing: Rate history on F2 in the Rate field of PUR-PO-01
r25.loc_text: p. 2, Purchasing: Rate history on F2 in the Rate field of PUR-PO-01
r25.quote: When a user places the cursor in the Rate field and presses F2, the system now displays the previous agreed purchasing rates for the selected item and supplier

r26.section: Purchasing: Rate history on F2 in the Rate field of PUR-PO-01
r26.loc_text: p. 2, Purchasing: Rate history on F2 in the Rate field of PUR-PO-01
r26.quote: select an entry to carry that rate back into the active order line, or dismiss the window without altering the value already typed.

r27.quote: Buyers at the Manchester plant and Leeds unit are advised to enter the initial characters of the item description rather than browsing the full list, which avoids the delay.

r28.section: Save on PUR-PO-01 needs Fetch for the current supplier and item: ERR-SCR-0221 FETCH NOT DONE.
r28.loc_text: p. 2, Save on PUR-PO-01 needs Fetch for the current supplier and item: ERR-SCR-0221 FETCH NOT DONE.
r28.quote: If an operator attempts to save without performing this retrieval step for the active combination, the transaction halts and the terminal displays ERR-SCR-0221 FETCH NOT DONE

r29.section: Orders saved against a closed cost centre are kept as Draft with warning W-CC-114 instead of being refused.
r29.loc_text: p. 3, Orders saved against a closed cost centre are kept as Draft with warning W-CC-114 instead of being refused.
r29.quote: Users working in Manchester and Leeds will observe that the confirmation banner is amber rather than green, and the document reference is generated while the commit action is held back.

r30.quote: This patch introduces an optional certificate check within the purchase order entry screen, PUR-PO-01, managed by the system parameter PUR.CERT_CHK. By default, the parameter remains set to N

r31.quote: saving an order on PUR-PO-01 will now present warning W-SUP-0207 UN38.3 CERTIFICATE MISSING OR EXPIRED if the supplier lacks an active UN38.3 certificate covering the order date. The screen simply presents this message in the status bar and allows the user to proceed.

r32.quote: Any interface service must log warning W-SUP-0207 UN38.3 CERTIFICATE MISSING OR EXPIRED rather than treating the response as a processing failure, allowing the order save to complete normally.

r33.file: 11_training/QRC-02 Raising a purchase order - Fetch first.pdf
r33.quote: PUR-PO-01: type STD and the approved PR number.

r34.file: 11_training/QRC-02 Raising a purchase order - Fetch first.pdf
r34.quote: Always press F3 Fetch once the supplier and item are entered on PUR-PO-01. Do not begin keying prices or descriptions by hand before this step has run.

r35.file: 11_training/QRC-02 Raising a purchase order - Fetch first.pdf
r35.quote: Changed the supplier or the item after Fetch? Press F3 again, or Save fails with ERR-SCR-0221.

r36.file: 11_training/QRC-02 Raising a purchase order - Fetch first.pdf
r36.section: Tips - Tax codes for overseas orders
r36.loc_text: p. 1, Tips - Tax codes for overseas orders
r36.quote: Where the vendor is located overseas, amend the default code from VAT20-UK to VAT20-RC.

r37.file: 11_training/QRC-02 Raising a purchase order - Fetch first.pdf
r37.quote: The text displayed along the bottom status bar merely confirms that the record has been written to the database; it does not confirm the purchasing status.

r39.quote: Fetch is optional; you can type the contract rate.

r40.quote: Enter any special carriage instructions in the delivery remarks field so that the goods inwards team are aware of oversized consignments or pallet drops.

r41.loc_text: p. 1, Multi-line purchase orders on PUR-PO-01
r41.quote: The revision to PUR-PO-01 introduces true multi-line purchase orders within a single document header.

r42.quote: A rejected certificate on a single cell line will prevent the entire document on PUR-PO-01 from saving, even if all mechanical lines on the order are fully compliant.
